name: binary-trading
description: Binary options trading platform — client, admin (React) and a Go backend

scripts.build: node scripts/go.mjs build -o bin/server ./cmd/server && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace admin
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/go.mjs vet ./... && npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace admin
scripts.test: node scripts/go.mjs test ./... && npm run test --workspace client
